description: This PHP script processes the saving of an email template in the vtiger CRM system. It handles both creating new email templates and updating existing ones, interacting with the database to store template details like folder name, subject, description, and body content.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security issues.

methods.name: from_html
methods.description: Converts HTML input into plain text or cleans it for safe storage.

methods.name: fck_from_html
methods.description: Processes HTML content from the FCK editor to a format suitable for storage.
